description: Building reference system — Ville de Laval is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Footprint of buildings on Laval territory produced by the City of Laval. To help understand the data, here are the descriptions of the fields used: ESPG: 32188 Field properties Name Description Type References/Comments IDSTRUCTURE Unique identifier of the Long building TYPE Indicates the type of building Text (50) Primary, secondary, agricultural, station, railway station BUILDINGNAME ... Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Building, Seated data, Imprint, Building, Government information. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
